steps.instruction: Read the one finding, raising evidence, current source, UI resolution and exact visual baseline. Freeze existing mutable files, size ceiling, prohibited layout changes and unchanged proof. Ask if the finding cannot be reproduced or the baseline is missing.

calls.purpose: Read the finding, resolution and current source.

steps.instruction: Reproduce the finding on current source, then edit the smallest declared existing file set using only values already authorized by the supplied resolution. Do not create or delete files or change layout direction.

calls.purpose: Reproduce the exact finding state before mutation.
calls.when: when browser evidence raises the finding

calls.purpose: Apply the smallest repair inside declared existing files.

steps.instruction: Render the same state and dependent viewports, capture actual pixels, run the unchanged proof and inspect baseline continuity. Give concrete feedback for any remaining defect. Delete rejected captures, repair only owning lines and reassess.

calls.purpose: Exercise the same finding path after repair.
Inspect result pixels beside the baseline.
Run unchanged targeted and dependent checks.
Persist proof, repair report and targeted source correction; remove rejected captures.

steps.instruction: Measure the final diff, create one local commit, re-read the committed tree and write the response. Validate all machine checks and criteria results before returning done.

calls.purpose: Verify the bounded diff and create one local repair commit.
Validate the compiled request and response.
